name: package_funding_harvest_v1
description: Funding-rate harvest sweep. Baseline funding_baseline_fixed6_365d: net +$15.14 on $400 notional in 365d = 3.78% APR. Tests whether wider symbol coverage + dynamic positive-carry-only filter + receive threshold tuning lifts APR to 8-12% without blowing variance. Grid: 4*3*3*2 = 72 combos. Targets: APR >= 6%, max month <= -1.0%, sharpe >= 1.5.

_notes.history: 2026-05-28: written by Opus. Pulls from existing scripts/backtest_funding_capture.py harness + strategies/funding_hold_v1.py. Baseline 365d run from 2026-04-03 showed +$15.14 net on $400 / 4 majors (BTC/DOGE/ETH/XRP).
_notes.hypothesis: Wider universe + tighter receive threshold should pick up alt funding without adding much variance. NEAR offered 10.95% annual in 2026-03 scan — but selection bias risk.
_notes.deploy_action: If winner APR >= 6%, max DD <= 4%, max neg month <= 1%: create sub-account on Bybit, transfer $300-500 to it, deploy as overlay layer (does NOT compete with main account margin).
